title: Grateful Dead Live at Niagara Falls Convention Center on 1979-10-24
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi DR-1)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Steve Rolfe's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5

ai_review.summary: Mislabeled Springfield Civic Center recording; no audio or performance details provided
ai_review.review: Both reviewers note that the tape is incorrectly titled as Niagara Falls and actually documents a concert at the Springfield Civic Center in Massachusetts. Beyond correcting the venue, they give no information about sound quality or musical performance, so listeners have little guidance on the recording’s technical merit.

ai_rating.rationale: Only two brief reviews focused solely on mislabeling; one gave 0 stars, the other 4 stars, providing no insight into sound or show quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments on clarity, mix, or source type; reviewers only mentioned incorrect venue labeling.
